CHANGELOG updated in PARENA: Shipped real shell functions, multi-line statement support (fixed a real architectural gap: one-line-at-a-time execution), and bare NAME=value assignment for parenash. Live-validated against the real EmilyOS hostname script -- parses/defines functions with zero errors, start() runs real logic, failing only on OpenRC's own ebegin/eend helpers (needs a source builtin, next). 8 new tests, all pass; make test 347/347.
